name: remove-integrity-profile-library
title: Remove Integrity-panel profile library (file profiles supersede it) + update specs
description: The three-tier file-profile system (P1) supersedes the Integrity panel's own profile library. Remove the select/Save as/Update/Rename/Delete profile UI, its host glue (registry re-exports), and the protocol messages; keep activeChecks persistence through the bound file profile. Update .trellis/spec/frontend/integrity-checks.md and hexscope-storage.md accordingly.
